name: HierarchyExplorer
tagline: Hierarchy Explorer shows any list where each record points to a parent as an organisation chart or tree.
description: Hierarchy Explorer shows any list where each record points to a parent as an organisation chart or tree. Instead of opening record after record to find out who reports to whom, users see the whole structure, search it, filter it by team and focus on one branch.
features: Search with highlighted matches, group filter
Drill-down with breadcrumb, details panel, status badges
A phone drill-down layout and selected key / title / path / report-count outputs
